entities.name: Gordana Marković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gordana Marković, also known as Gordana Marković-Jovanović, is a Serbian chess player who holds the title of Woman International Master. She is a two-time winner of the Yugoslav Women's Chess Championship and won a team bronze medal with the Yugoslav women's team at the 1988 Chess Olympiad.
